verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is that Martin can create, read, add to, and edit notes from any interface, including dictating a named note over a call. This gives minimal, glancing support for iteratively editing text content. Nothing shows document, presentation, or general file creation, or any export. Missing for 10: document/file creation beyond internal notes, presentation generation, export to downloadable formats (e.g., DOCX/PDF/PPTX), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
